economic_interpretation: The one-day publication lag is unverified. Raw fractions, archive event time, settlement, native venue funding and availability remain UNCONFIRMED; this is conditional historical accounting.

Primary paired comparison is net_PnL difference at identical initial capital and cost in each complete 122/90 window separately. Report minute/all-observation DD, realized exposures, turnover, fee and monthly continuous NAV without choosing months.

Numerically indistinguishable deltas within the preregistered accounting error are no measurable improvement. Net improvements inconsistent across windows, no gate activation, or major conditional positive coupon sacrifice are not evidence for adoption.
If numeric risk-improvement or major-coupon-sacrifice adoption thresholds are desired, freeze them before new arrays; do not invent a post-result pass criterion.
Foregone coupon is only post-result saved-control conditional ownership attribution after the gate exit, not a trading signal, actual funding receipt or NAV cashflow.

Mechanical annualization of a seen short sample is not long-term net CAGR/APR or a qualified candidate. Pause negative/no-increment gate; reopen only new past-available state or genuine time-out evidence, not 3/14/30day window search.
